tasks.name: Improve 3D Lighting
tasks.instruction: Add wall sconces (small orange point lights at y=2.5) every 6 units along the left and right walls of the main corridor. Each sconce should have a small emissive cube mesh (0.15 x 0.15 x 0.08) mounted on the wall to represent the fixture. Use warm color 0xffaa55 with intensity 1.2 and distance 8.

tasks.name: Add Room Labels
tasks.instruction: In the HUD overlay, add a subtle compass indicator showing N/S/E/W based on the camera yaw angle stored in stateRef.current.yaw. Position it below the minimap.
